claim_support.topic: requested, produced, serialized and consumed treatment are separate observations
claim_support.limit: Static feedback-to-next-prompt wiring is not runtime delivery proof. Exported best-effort profiling does not implement the stated first-keep stop; external operational checkpoints are unknown.

Both arms miss this source-specific minimum of 15 usable iterations out of 20, while the paper concludes a shared-wall null. Preserve the conflict and withhold a valid causal null under the stated precedence; no numerical default is introduced.

claim_support.topic: declared protocol, reachable enforcement and persisted gate evidence differ
claim_support.limit: Current ingest checks do not enforce every frozen field; shape minimum is not enforced by G3; loop records emit n/a. No malformed-packet execution or complete security audit was run.

claim_support.topic: denominator, admitted/quarantined counts and median conflict
claim_support.limit: PyTorch eager is the reported Level-1 denominator, not evidence against an unmeasured strong compiled baseline. README 1.0005x and table/paper 1.0001x remain unreconciled. The contextual greater-than-10x breaker is not an InferRSI default.

conflicts_and_access_limits: Paper invalid-arm precedence conflicts with its shared-wall-null interpretation for the reported usable counts.
ARTIFACT maps the first-keep stop to loop.py, but that exported path tolerates missing profiling and continues; original external operational checkpoints are unavailable.
Original plans/P6 report and protocol-notes referenced by source comments are absent from the complete pinned public tree. The full registration and actual prompt receipts were not reconstructed.
Level-1 results README explicitly preserves 1.0005x versus TABLE.md/paper 1.0001x pending reconciliation.
The public repository is a September export with an abbreviated parent autoserv revision; that prefix is not expanded into an invented experimental commit.
exclusions: No source implementation, vendored dependency, raw ledger, PDF or figure bytes redistributed.
Generic matched-budget, independent complete-output oracle, repair accounting and search-headroom procedures are existing-owner responsibilities, not new extractions in this increment.
Engine configuration tuning, remote execution, baseline reproduction, native correctness and source-test execution are outside this source-only amendment.
